name: conditionGrid

frames.best_why: All four tiles show their photo, title pill and arrow at once, with the cursor clear of the labels.

tagline: A lopsided grid of four product photos with black name pills and arrow buttons.
summary: A responsive twelve-column project grid: two wide photos on top and two staggered below, each with a rounded image, a black title pill and a circular arrow link.
appearance: Four photographs sit in a tight, offset grid on a white page: a tall black-shoe shot and a wide blue-lit sneaker shot above, a wide blue-toned shot and a narrower tan-boot shot below, each with rounded corners. Every tile carries a black rounded name pill at lower left and a black circular arrow at lower right.
behaviour: Tiles slide up and fade in as they enter the viewport, revealing the photo and then its black overlay labels; the layout reflows from four uneven columns on desktop to stacked full-width tiles on small screens.
demo_content: Sneaker and boot product photos titled Distrokings, Profitables, Topserve-copiers and Labramart.
search_phrases: product photo grid with arrow links
photos that slide up on scroll
use_when: A portfolio or agency page needs a compact, editorial grid of project images.
avoid_when: The demo hardcodes four Unsplash photos and their titles, so real projects need a source edit.
customise: Projects are a hardcoded array inside the file (image URL, title, description); add or edit entries there, and change column spans by editing the index rules in the code.
weight_why: Four images and a simple fade-slide animation; idle once they settle.

a11y.note: Every image has the same generic alt text 'image' and the arrow is a decorative div, so screen readers get little meaning; no reduced-motion handling.

issues: All four images share the alt text 'image', which describes nothing.
The description field in each project is never displayed.
polish_why: Crisp staggered grid and tidy labels; generic alt text and unused descriptions are misses.
